# KorvenzaTech

Official website: https://korvenzatech.com/

KorvenzaTech is a technology company offering AI solutions, SaaS development, mobile app development, website and web application development, custom API development, custom business software, cloud/backend solutions, UI/UX design, and digital growth services.

Founder & CEO: Muhammad Rashid. Public company profile does not publish education or private personal details.
